decisions.reason: As a LED track spotlight it builds directly on the firm's existing lighting design, planning and sales-support knowledge, so under absorptive capacity logic the firm is well placed to learn from early market feedback and refine rather than withdraw it.

As a LED ceiling luminaire close to the core range, it fits the firm's established capabilities, customer base and broad product-line strategy, making continued development and retention more likely than exit after only one year on the market.
